senses.gloss: औत्तमि औत्तमि, i. e. उत्तम + इ, patron. m. The name of a Manu, Man. 1, 62.
औत्तर औत्तर (? if correct it would be उत्तर + अ), adj. Inhabiting the north, MBh. 3, 10546 (probably it must be corrected यत्रोत्त्˚).
औत्तानपाद औत्तानपाद, and -पादि -पादि, i. e. उत्तान-पाद (a proper name) + अ or इ, patron. m. Dhruva or the polar star, MBh. 13, 195; Bhāg. P. 4, 8, 82.
